function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed
